design: Exploratory, descriptive reanalysis of previously locked outputs; not preregistration or external confirmation
shuffle: Reuse original deterministic split-wise permutation: default_rng(seed+7919+part_index), train/tune/gate indices0/1/2. Permute full split before selecting geometry subset. One existing draw per seed, not a permutation null distribution.
metrics: entropy effective rank of uncentered unit-diagonal Gram
cost_scope: No cost assigned to matched-shuffled Gram: no newly fitted classifier. Separately tuned archived shuffled-model costs remain a different diagnostic.
reconstruction: Deterministic Gram reconstruction from stored PCA features, train-only encoder and locked geometry; verify actual product against archived Gram before constructing matched shuffled product.
interpretation: All160 related cases retained; descriptive counts and means only. Overlapping holdouts, one existing shuffle and post-hoc settings preclude independent-sample or causal claims. Full-split score multiset preserved; the geometry subsample multiset need not be identical.
